crossRefs.note: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for his loving kindness endures forever:
May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
Though men may rise up to pursue you, and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of…
David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall go down into battle and…
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

translations.web: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.
translations.bsb: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
translations.kjv: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
translations.asv: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant. Psalm 144 A Psalm of David.
